description.en: MPDocBench-Parse is a benchmark for multi-page document parsing, covering 433 manually annotated documents with 3,246 pages across 15 document types in English and Chinese. It evaluates content fidelity and logical structure, including text, table, formula recognition, reading order, and heading hierarchy recovery.
